title: Your First Flight
description: Launch a camera-equipped, balloon-assisted quadcopter from the school athletic field and recover it safely using the same simulation rules as every other flight. A battery pack is provided with the starter aircraft; recovery still depends on whether the aircraft can actually reduce lift and descend.

objectives.description: Use the stabilized camera payload to capture an aerial view of the school while remaining near the school athletic field.
Recover the camera-equipped aircraft without crashing.
